race.comment: SPIRIT OF BARTY (12) has been knocking hard with a string of seconds, including a long-neck defeat as favourite at Eagle Farm when held up near the turn. Gets in light and has strong claims. BONDED AFFAIR (3) arrives off a Sunshine Coast win and is a distance specialist. Strips rock-hard fit on the short turnaround but finds a hot race. PALEFACE RINGO (5) could land in a tricky spot from the inside but will get a tempo to suit. Like him dropping back to this trip off a mile and he looks a knockout chance if they overdo it. GREYZOUS (9) is a two-time fresh winner who will be ready to go off three trials.
